releaseScope: City first; non-City maps deferred; 23 required leaves / one optional expansion
releaseEvidence: No WSE2 executable gameplay yet. Do not move a leaf to done on simulated tests alone.

coordination.handoff: GitHub branch/PR + evidence, never chat-only handoffs
coordination.approval: Agents may implement/review in own branch; no blind automatic merge, no CI, no Pages edits by agents B/C.
coordination.updates: Only Agent A edits progress/ledger.json and republishes public gh-pages snapshot after scope/evidence review; others propose updates in PR.
coordination.privacy: Never commit original RAR, game assets, Windows user paths, logs containing identity, secrets or private readiness assessments.

A.name: City engine and integrator
firstWave: ZOM-ENG-01 — implement original archive integrity/preflight test harness without requiring manual user testing
ZOM-ENG-02 — WSE2 startup capability research, City boot/mission contract and sandboxed validation fixture
ZOM-REC-01..03 — reconcile toolkit and tracker tests when possible
later: Gameplay bot combat and City positions only after runtime evidence
Original optional non-City maps stay out of first release

B.name: Windows installer and solo launcher
firstWave: ZOM-WIN-01 — detector: Steam libraries, custom paths, WSE2 candidates and explicit ambiguity with fixture tests
ZOM-WIN-02 — reversible dry-run installer + manifest and rollback design
ZOM-SOLO-01 — private host lifecycle design with fake process, no runtime assertion
later: WIN-03 desktop shortcut and launcher UI
SOLO-02 auto-join gated on observed engine CLI

C.name: Flight recorder and forensic diagnostics
firstWave: ZOM-OBS-02 — external crash-resistant, bounded local process/log sidecar with fixture tests
ZOM-OBS-01 — WSE2 Lua operations audit + event schema with unavailable/unknown semantics
ZOM-QA-01 — self-contained forensic evidence bundle including launcher metadata, redaction and SHA-256
later: PERF-01 process, frame metric availability and profiling
QA-02 evidence report for the eventual one-time final integrated Windows City session

interfaces.installation: Agent B discovers executable and original archive candidates; Agent A's tools/build.py remains source of truth for verified RAR and compilation. Agent B invokes it via subprocess/CLI. No private assets in repository.
interfaces.session: Agent B writes local JSON session receipt in per-user directory containing session ID, start/end timestamps, local-only launch mode, module build fingerprint and process status. Agent C consumes read-only; exact v1 contract documented by Agent A.
interfaces.events: Agent C owns ZDB1 Lua events and evidence schema; Agent A does not change Lua telemetry. Unknown getter remains unknown, never 0.
interfaces.acceptance: No runtime tests available until the one final user-guided Windows session. Offline tests may advance implementation but not release-acceptance counts.

gates.goal: First actual WSE2 City probe with combined harness
requires: A original archive and game compatibility
C independent recorder and expected manifest
gates.userAction: one combined Windows evidence session once ready

requires: At least two allied AI actually fight
